summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch previewed the wrestling match between William Miller and Theobaud Bauer, listing Miller's record, including a January 1875 boxing win over Bill Davis, an old opponent of Tom Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch, Wednesday Evening, September 27, 1876'; pre-1878-12, so not the Post-Dispatch

notes: Allen is named only as a past opponent of Bill Davis; no facts about Allen himself.
